questions.text: मान लीजिए, औसत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (APC) का मूल्य 0.8 है तथा राष्ट्रीय आय ₹ 4,000 करोड़ है, तो बचत का मूल्य ₹ _______ करोड़ होगा ।
questions.text_english: Suppose, the value of Average Propensity to Consume (APC) is 0.8 and National Income is _______ 4,000 crores, the value of saving would be _______ crores.
questions.instruction_line: (सही विकल्प द्वारा रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें ।)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill up the blank)
questions.solution: National Income (Y) is 4000 crores and APC is 0.8. Consumption (C) = APC * Y = 0.8 * 4000 = 3200 crores. Saving (S) = Y - C = 4000 - 3200 = 800 crores. Therefore, option (D) is correct.

questions.text: मान लीजिए, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था का बचत वक्र ₹50 करोड़ के ऋणात्मक मूल्य पर अवरोध (intercept) बनता है। अर्थव्यवस्था में, आय में वृद्धि का 20% बचत के रूप में रखा जाता है। उपरोक्त संदर्भ के आलोक में, निवेश गुणक (K) के मूल्य की पहचान करें।
questions.text_english: Suppose, the saving curve of an economy makes an intercept at a negative value of 50 crores. In the economy, 20% of an increase in income is saved. In the light of above context, identify the value of investment multiplier (K).
questions.solution: Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS) is 20%, which is 0.2. The formula for investment multiplier is K = 1/MPS = 1/0.2 = 5. Thus, option (B) is correct.

questions.text: वाणिज्यिक बैंकों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन सत्य हैं ? (I) बैंकों के लिए जमाएँ देनदारियाँ होती हैं। (II) वे अर्थव्यवस्था में साख सृजक होते हैं। (III) वे आम जनता से जमा स्वीकार करते हैं। (IV) वे भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक की ओर से जमा स्वीकार करते हैं।
questions.text_english: In the context of the Commercial Banks, which of the following statements are correct? (I) Deposits received are liabilities for Commercial Banks. (II) They are creator of credit in the economy. (III) They accept deposits from general public. (IV) They accept deposits on behalf of Reserve Bank of India.
questions.solution: Commercial banks accept deposits from the public, which are their liabilities (I, III are correct). They perform credit creation (II is correct). They do not accept deposits on behalf of the RBI (IV is incorrect). Thus, option (A) is correct.

questions.text: यदि कोई राष्ट्र ₹ 600 करोड़ का माल निर्यात करता है तथा ₹ 450 करोड़ का माल आयात करता है, तो राष्ट्र के व्यापार संतुलन का मूल्य ₹ _______ करोड़ का _______ होगा ।
questions.text_english: If a country exports goods worth of 600 crores and imports goods worth of 450 crores, the value of Balance of Trade of the country would be _______ of _______ crores.
questions.solution: Balance of Trade (BOT) = Exports - Imports. BOT = 600 - 450 = +150 crores. Since the value is positive, it is a surplus of 150 crores. Option (B) is correct.

questions.text: कॉलम-I व कॉलम-II में दिए गए पदों के समूह में से सही युग्म का चयन करें :
questions.text_english: From the set of terms given in Column-I and Column-II, choose the correct pair:
questions.solution: Borrowings are capital receipts/expenditure related (c-iii is correct). Other pairings like Goods and Services Tax are indirect taxes, not non-tax revenue. Option (C) is the only correct match.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें : कथन 1 : प्रबंधित तिरती विनिमय दर प्रणाली स्थिर व नम्य विनिमय दर प्रणाली का एक समामेलन है। कथन 2 : प्रबंधित तिरती विनिमय दर प्रणाली को 'हाईब्रिड प्रणाली' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है। दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement-1 : Managed floating exchange rate system is an amalgamation of fixed and flexible exchange rate system. Statement-2: Managed floating exchange rate system is also known as 'hybrid system'. In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Managed floating system combines elements of fixed and flexible rates, often called a hybrid system. Both statements are factually correct. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: कॉलम-I व कॉलम-II में दी गई मदों में से सही युग्म का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: From the items given in Column-I and Column-II, choose the correct pair.
questions.solution: Entrepreneurship income is profit (b-ii is correct). Other options (a, c, d) are incorrectly matched with items like old age pension or rent-free accommodation. Option (B) is the correct pair.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों-अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) का अध्ययन करें। नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन करें : अभिकथन (A) : सार्वजनिक वस्तुएँ वे वस्तुएँ हैं, जिनका उपभोग जनता द्वारा सामूहिक रूप से किया जाता है। कारण (R) : सार्वजनिक वस्तुएँ बहिष्कृत एवं प्रतिद्वन्द्वात्मक प्रकृति की होती हैं।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct option from those given below : Assertion (A): Public goods are those goods that are collectively consumed by the public. Reason (R): Public goods are excludable and rivalrous in nature.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है。

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A)
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Public goods are non-excludable and non-rivalrous, so the reason is false, while the assertion correctly identifies them as collectively consumed. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: भुगतान संतुलन के चालू खाते लेनदेन के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से असत्य कथन की पहचान करें :
questions.text_english: In the context of Current Account transactions of Balance of Payment, identify the incorrect statement from the following:

options.A: वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के निर्यात को क्रेडिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज किया जाता है।
options.B: वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के आयात को डेबिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज किया जाता है।
options.C: सभी हस्तांतरण भुगतान डेबिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज किए जाते हैं।
options.D: सभी हस्तांतरण प्राप्तियाँ डेबिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज की जाती हैं。

options_english.A: Export of goods and services are recorded as credit items.
options_english.B: Import of goods and services are recorded as debit items.
options_english.C: All transfer payments are recorded as debit items.
options_english.D: All transfer receipts are recorded as debit items.

questions.solution: Transfer receipts are inflows of money, which should be recorded as credit items, not debit items. Therefore, statement (D) is incorrect.

questions.text: "इरफान (एक छात्र) ने अपनी कॉलेज की फीस के लिए ₹80,000 का ऋण लिया है। वह स्नातक होने के छह माह बाद ऋण चुकाना प्रारंभ करने की योजना बना रहा है, जिसे वह 10 वर्ष की अवधि में चुकाएगा।" उपरोक्त गद्य के आधार पर मुद्रा के निर्दिष्ट कार्य की पहचान करें।
questions.text_english: "Irfaan (a student) borrows ₹80,000 to finance his college fees. He plans to begin repaying the loan six months after graduation and will repay it over a period of ten years." Based on the above text, identify the indicated function of money.
questions.solution: The ability to repay a loan over a period of time is a function of money known as the standard of deferred payments. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: (a) साधन लागत पर शुद्ध मूल्य वृद्धि $(NVA_{FC})$ के मूल्य की गणना करें : [Table provided]
questions.text_english: (a) Calculate the value of Net Value Added at Factor Cost $(NVA_{FC})$ : [Table provided]

sub_questions.text: तालिका के आधार पर NVA FC ज्ञात करें।
sub_questions.text_english: Calculate NVA FC based on the table.
sub_questions.solution: Value of Output = Sales + Increase in unsold stock = 10625 + 600 = 11225. Gross Value Added at Market Price (GVA MP) = Value of Output - Purchase of raw materials = 11225 - 2625 = 8600. Net Value Added at Market Price (NVA MP) = GVA MP - Consumption of fixed capital = 8600 - 500 = 8100. NVA FC = NVA MP - (Indirect taxes - Subsidies) = 8100 - (1200 - 400) = 8100 - 800 = 7300 crores.

questions.text: "सभी उपभोग वस्तुएँ टिकाऊ प्रवृत्ति की होती हैं।" उपयुक्त उदाहरण द्वारा, उपरोक्त कथन का समर्थन अथवा खंडन करें।
questions.text_english: "All consumption goods are durable in nature." Defend or refute the given statement with the help of a suitable example.

key_points: Explain non-durable and semi-durable goods exist
Provide examples like food items (non-durable) and clothes (semi-durable)

questions.solution: I refute the statement. Not all consumption goods are durable. Consumption goods are classified into durable, semi-durable, and non-durable categories. Durable goods like refrigerators last for years. Non-durable goods like bread or milk are consumed in a single act of consumption. Semi-durable goods like clothes have a limited life span.

questions.text: "हाल के बजट में, सरकार ने सार्वजनिक परिवहन में सुधार तथा प्रदूषण में कमी करने के लिए स्मार्ट शहरों में नई मेट्रो लाइनों के निर्माण के लिए धन आवंटित किया है।" उपरोक्त सरकारी व्यय की प्रकृति व उसके उद्देश्य की पहचान करें।
questions.text_english: "In the recent Budget, the Government allocated funds for the construction of new metro lines in smart cities to improve public transportation and reduce pollution." Identify the nature of the government expenditure and its objective.
questions.solution: The nature of this expenditure is capital expenditure because it leads to the creation of a physical asset (metro lines) which provides benefits over a long period. The objective is social welfare and economic development by improving public transportation and reducing pollution in urban areas, thereby contributing to the quality of life.

questions.text: मान लीजिए, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में प्राथमिक जमा ₹ 500 है, यदि आरक्षित अनुपात 25% है। बैंकिंग प्रणाली द्वारा सृजित कुल जमा राशियों तथा कुल उधार (ऋण) का अनुमान लगाएँ ।
questions.text_english: Suppose in an economy, primary deposits are ₹500, if the Reserve Ratio is 25%. Estimate the total deposits created and the total lending by the banking system.

key_points: Total Lending = Total Deposits - Initial Deposits = 2000 - 500 = 1500

questions.solution: Money Multiplier = 1 / Reserve Ratio = 1 / 0.25 = 4. Total deposits created = Primary deposits * Money Multiplier = 500 * 4 = 2000 crores. Total lending = Total deposits - Initial deposits = 2000 - 500 = 1500 crores.

questions.text: (a) एक अर्थव्यवस्था में; $C=200+0.75 Y$ (जहाँ $C=$ उपभोग व्यय है, तथा $Y=$ राष्ट्रीय आय है) निवेश व्यय = ₹ 4,000 करोड़ है। निम्नलिखित की गणना करें : (i) आय का संतुलन स्तर (ii) आय के संतुलन स्तर पर कुल उपभोग व्यय
questions.text_english: (a) In an economy; $C=200+0.75 Y$ (where C is consumption expenditure and Y is National Income). Investment expenditure is 4,000 Crore. Calculate the following: (i) Equilibrium level of income. (ii) Total consumption expenditure at equilibrium income level.
questions.solution: At equilibrium level of income: Y = C + I. Given C = 200 + 0.75Y and I = 4000. So, Y = 200 + 0.75Y + 4000. Subtract 0.75Y from both sides: 0.25Y = 4200. Y = 4200 / 0.25 = 16800 crores. (ii) Total consumption expenditure = C = 200 + 0.75(16800) = 200 + 12600 = 12800 crores.

questions.text:
केन्द्रीय खाद्य व उपभोक्ता मामले के मंत्री ने कहा कि, सरकार ने खाद्य वस्तुओं की खुदरा (retail) कीमतों को नियंत्रित करने के लिए विगत वर्षों में कई सक्रिय कदम उठाए हैं। उन्होंने कहा कि, सरकार का लक्ष्य राष्ट्र की आर्थिक वृद्धि से समझौता किए बिना मुद्रास्फीति को नियंत्रण में रखना है। नवंबर 2023 में खुदरा मुद्रास्फीति 5.55% के तीन माह के उच्चतम स्तर पर पहुँच गई, जो कि खाद्य पदार्थों की बढ़ती कीमतों के कारण है। अगस्त 2023 में मुद्रास्फीति में गिरावट आयी थी, जब यह 6.83% पर पहुँच गई थी । आवश्यक वस्तुओं की थोक (wholesale) व खुदरा (retail) मूल्यों पर कड़ी निगरानी रखने हेतु केन्द्र सरकार ने 140 नए मूल्य निगरानी केन्द्र स्थापित किए हैं।

सरकार ने गेहूँ, टूटे चावल, गैर-बासमती सफेद चावल, प्याज आदि कई खाद्य पदार्थों के निर्यात पर प्रतिबंध लगा दिया है। घरेलू आपूर्ति को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए तथा मूल्य वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने के लिए सरकार ने तिलहन व दलहन पर आयात शुल्क भी कम कर दिया है।
questions.text_english:
Union Food and Consumer Affairs Minister said that the Central Government has taken many proactive steps in the past few years to control retail prices of food items. He said that the government aims to keep inflation under control without compromising the country's economic growth. Retail inflation inched up to a three-month high of 5.55% in November 2023 driven by higher food prices. Inflation has been declining since August 2023, when it touched 6.83%. 140 new price monitoring centres had been set up by the Central Government to keep a close watch on wholesale and retail prices of essential commodities.

The Government has banned the export of many food items like wheat, broken rice, non-basmati white rice, onions etc. It has also reduced import duties on edible oils and pulses to boost domestic supply and control price rise.
questions.instruction_line: उपरोक्त गद्य व सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें :
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of the given text and common understanding, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: सरकार द्वारा स्थापित नए मूल्य निगरानी केन्द्रों की संख्या बताएँ ।
sub_questions.text_english: Mention the number of new price monitoring centres set up by government.
sub_questions.solution: The Central Government has established 140 new price monitoring centres.

sub_questions.text: घरेलू आपूर्ति को प्रोत्साहित करने व मूल्यों में कमी लाने के लिए सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए किन्हीं दो सक्रिय उपायों का उल्लेख करें ।
sub_questions.text_english: State any two proactive measures taken by government to boost domestic supply and reduction in prices.

key_points: Ban on exports of food items
Reduction of import duties on edible oils and pulses

sub_questions.solution: Two proactive measures taken by the government are: (1) Banning the export of essential food items like wheat and rice. (2) Reducing import duties on edible oils and pulses to increase their domestic availability.

sub_questions.text: मुद्रास्फीति को नियंत्रित करने के लिए प्रयुक्त किसी एक मौद्रिक उपाय की व्याख्या करें ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any one monetary measure used to control inflation.
sub_questions.solution: One common monetary measure is raising the Repo Rate. When the RBI increases the Repo Rate, commercial banks increase their lending rates, which makes borrowing costlier for households and firms. This reduces consumption and investment spending, ultimately lowering the money supply and controlling inflationary pressures.

questions.text: (a) (i) मूल्यवर्धन विधि द्वारा राष्ट्रीय आय का आकलन करते समय अपनाई जाने वाली किन्हीं दो सावधानियों की व्याख्या करें। (ii) "उच्च सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) का अर्थ सदैव अर्थव्यवस्था में वस्तुओं की प्रति व्यक्ति अधि-उपलब्धता होता है।" उपरोक्त कथन का उस देश के लोगों के कल्याण के सूचकांक के रूप में समर्थन अथवा खंडन करें।
questions.text_english: (a) (i) Explain any two precautions to be adopted while estimating National Income by the Value Added Method. (ii) "Higher Gross Domestic Product (GDP) always means higher per capita availability of goods in the economy." Defend or refute the given statement as an index of the welfare of the people of that country.

key_points: Precautions: Do not include intermediate goods, Avoid double counting, Exclude sale of second hand goods
Does not account for non-monetary exchanges

questions.solution:
(i) Two precautions while using the Value Added method: (1) Avoid double counting of intermediate goods; only the value added at each stage should be included. (2) Exclude the sale and purchase of second-hand goods as they were already accounted for in the year they were produced.
(ii) I refute the statement. GDP is not an accurate index of welfare because an increase in GDP may be due to an increase in production of goods that do not necessarily improve the welfare of the common person. Furthermore, if the GDP growth is accompanied by increased income inequality, per capita availability for the poor may not rise. Also, externalities like pollution are not considered.

questions.text: 'यह अल्पकालिक बेरोज़गारी है, जो लोगों के एक नौकरी से दूसरी नौकरी में जाने के कारण उत्पन्न होती है।' दी गई परिभाषा के आधार पर इंगित बेरोज़गारी के प्रकार की पहचान कीजिए।
questions.text_english: "It is short-term unemployment occurring as people transit between jobs." On the basis of the given definition, identify the type of unemployment indicated.
questions.solution: Unemployment that occurs when workers are in the process of moving from one job to another is known as Frictional Unemployment. Option (D) is correct.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें। नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन करें : अभिकथन (A): आर्थिक सुधारों से पूर्व, चीन द्वारा सामाजिक संरचना पर सार्वजनिक निवेश के परिणामस्वरूप बेहतर मानव विकास संकेतक (HDI) प्राप्त हुए थे । कारण (R) : चीन कई मानव विकास संकेतकों (HDI) में भारत व पाकिस्तान से आगे है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Reason (R) China is ahead of India and Pakistan on many Human Development Indicators (HDI).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है。

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: China's early investments in social sectors like health and education are indeed the reasons why it performs better than India and Pakistan in HDI today. Both statements are true and the reason explains the assertion. Option (A) is correct.

questions.text: भौतिक पूँजी व मानव पूँजी में अंतर स्पष्ट करें ।
questions.text_english: Distinguish between Physical Capital and Human Capital.

key_points: Human: skills, knowledge, health of people

questions.solution: Physical capital refers to tangible assets like machinery, buildings, and tools used for production. Human capital refers to the stock of skills, knowledge, and health that people possess, which enhances their productive capacity. Physical capital is separable from its owner, while human capital is embodied in the individual and inseparable.

questions.text: (a) "विगत समयावधि में सहकारी समितियों को झटका लगा है।" उपरोक्त कथन का वैध स्पष्टीकरण द्वारा औचित्य सिद्ध करें।
questions.text_english: (a) "Cooperatives have received a setback during the recent past." Justify the given statement with a valid explanation.
questions.solution: Cooperatives have faced setbacks due to several reasons, including poor management, excessive political interference, lack of professional skill sets among members, and stiff competition from more efficient private sector organizations. Many cooperative societies have become financially insolvent, leading to a decline in their effectiveness in supporting farmers.

questions.text: (a) भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के योजना उद्देश्य के रूप में 'आत्म निर्भरता' के चयन के पीछे के तर्कों का संक्षिप्त वर्णन करें ।
questions.text_english: (a) Describe briefly a rationale behind choosing 'Self-reliance' as a planning objective for the Indian economy.
questions.solution: The rationale for 'Self-reliance' as a planning objective was to ensure that India reduced its dependence on foreign nations for essential goods, particularly food and capital. It was aimed at maintaining political sovereignty and avoiding foreign political interference in domestic economic policy-making, especially given the experience of colonization and the need to build a strong indigenous industrial base.

questions.text: (a) "पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में लघु जल विद्युत संयंत्र लागत प्रभावी होने के साथ-साथ पर्यावरण अनुकूल भी साबित होते हैं।" उपरोक्त कथन को वैध तर्क द्वारा प्रमाणित करें। (b) वहन क्षमता को परिभाषित करें।
questions.text_english: (a) "In the mountainous regions, mini-hydel plants prove to be cost-effective as well as eco-friendly." Justify the above statement with valid arguments. (b) Define carrying capacity.

key_points: Carrying capacity: environment's ability to support life/activity without degradation

questions.solution: (a) Mini-hydel plants in mountains are cost-effective because they require smaller infrastructure and avoid large-scale dam construction, saving on displacement and relocation costs. They are eco-friendly because they do not require large reservoirs or widespread deforestation. (b) Carrying capacity refers to the ability of an ecosystem to support a certain level of life or economic activity without resulting in environmental degradation.

questions.text: पाकिस्तान द्वारा अपने आर्थिक विकास पथ के लिए उठाए गए विकासात्मक कदमों का वर्णन करें ।
questions.text_english: Describe the path of developmental initiatives taken by Pakistan for its economic development.
questions.solution: Pakistan adopted a mixed economy framework with an emphasis on both public and private sectors. Early developmental initiatives included import substitution industrialization, which aimed to protect domestic industries. The government introduced Green Revolution technologies to boost agricultural productivity. Furthermore, Pakistan has historically relied on external financial assistance, including foreign aid and remittances, to fund its developmental goals and infrastructure projects.

questions.text:
कृषि-स्टार्टअप व ग्रामीण उद्यम भारत में ग्रामीण विकास के लिए तीव्रता से महत्वपूर्ण होते जा रहे हैं। वे भारत में ग्रामीण क्षेत्र में आने वाली गंभीर चुनौतियों का समाधान प्रस्तुत करते हैं। ये उद्यम उन्नत कृषि, IT-आधारित निगरानी प्रणाली व डेटा आधारित निर्णय लेने वाले उपकरण जैसे तकनीकी नवाचार लाते हैं, जो उत्पादकता व संसाधन दक्षता में वृद्धि करते हैं।

आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं को सुव्यवस्थित करके व प्रत्यक्ष बाजार से संपर्क स्थापित करके वे कृषकों के लिए उचित मूल्य निर्धारण सुनिश्चित करते हैं तथा पारंपरिक बिचौलियों पर निर्भरता भी कम करते हैं। ऐसे उद्यम ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में रोजगार सृजन में सक्रिय रूप से योगदान प्रदान करते हैं। सरकार ने RKVY-RAFTAAR, कृषि अवसंरचना कोष तथा Agri-SURE आदि विभिन्न कार्यक्रमों के माध्यम से कृषि स्टार्टअपों व उद्यमियों के लिए निरंतर नीति व वित्तीय सहायता का प्रदर्शन किया है।
questions.text_english:
Agro-startups and rural enterprises are becoming increasingly vital for rural development in India. They address the critical challenges faced by rural sector in India. These ventures bring in technological innovations such as precision farming, IT-based monitoring system and data-driven decision making tools that enhance productivity and resource efficiency.

By streamlining supply chains and creating direct market linkages, they ensure better pricing for farmers and reduce dependency on traditional intermediaries. Such enterprises contribute actively to employment generation in the rural areas. The government has demonstrated a continuous policy and financial support for agri-startups and entrepreneurs through various programs like RKVY-RAFTAAR, the Agri-infrastructure fund and Agri-SURE.

sub_questions.text: भारत में कृषि स्टार्टअपों व उद्यमियों को समर्थन देने में सरकार की भूमिका पर टिप्पणी करें।

sub_questions.solution: The government plays a crucial role by providing consistent policy and financial support through specific programs like RKVY-RAFTAAR, the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund, and Agri-SURE, helping to foster innovation and entrepreneurship in the rural agricultural sector.

questions.text_english: (a) Giving valid reasons, state whether the following statements are true or false. (i) There was growth in agricultural sector due to expansion of aggregate area under cultivation, during the colonial era. (ii) The objective of World Trade Organisation (WTO) is to establish a rule based regime, in the world trade. (iii) Economic growth with regional disparity was the main goal of planning in India.

key_points: (i) True: Cultivation spread, (ii) True: WTO role, (iii) False: Aimed at reducing regional disparity

questions.solution: (i) True: During the colonial era, agricultural production grew mainly due to the expansion of land under cultivation rather than increased productivity. (ii) True: The WTO's primary role is to ensure that global trade flows smoothly and predictably based on established rules. (iii) False: The goal of planning was 'Growth with Social Justice' and balanced regional development, so planning aimed to reduce, not increase, regional disparities.
